protocols.algorithm: stage-major StableRNG draw from the frozen support; the screening protocol is drawn from an independent seed and repaired against the final protocol's columns, so the two panels are disjoint by construction

regions.algorithm: demand-BALANCED assignment over unit-norm PTDF sensitivity signatures on the highest-reach rated corridors: farthest-point initialization, then Lloyd sweeps whose assignment step is a HiGHS integer program minimizing demand-weighted signature distance subject to per-region demand-share bounds; regions relabelled by descending demand
